# Duel options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

7 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World:Duel`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Master switch. Off, the duel spell refuses with SPELL_FAILED_NO_DUELING. Default on (every character knows spell 7266, playercreateinfo_spell). |
| `ExpiredRequestIsSilent` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | Both references end an unaccepted request whose flag object expired as FLED (Player.cpp:6677-6683), which announces a winner. On, that case completes as INTERRUPTED instead (no winner message). |
| `OutOfBoundsGraceSeconds` | `int` | `10` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Seconds out of bounds before the duel is lost as fled (10 in both references). |
| `OutOfBoundsYards` | `float` | `50` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Yards from the flag at which the out-of-bounds warning starts: 50 as in original 1.12 (mangos-classic Player.cpp:6917-6937). vmangos widens it to 75 ("Nostalrius: modified duel distance (50 -&gt; 75m)", Player.cpp:6688-6716), the option for that behaviour. Retail by default. |
| `RequireKnownArea` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | start | vmangos permits a duel when a player's area has no AreaTable row (SpellEffects.cpp:4689-4701 tests the flag only when the row exists). On, an unknown area refuses with SPELL_FAILED_NO_DUELING. |
| `ReturnInBoundsYards` | `float` | `40` | a number, '.' is the decimal point | World | start | Yards within which a player who left the area counts as back: 40 as in original 1.12 (mangos-classic), 70 in vmangos. |
| `StartDelaySeconds` | `int` | `3` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Seconds between the accept and the start (vmangos Player::UpdateDuelFlag, Player.cpp:17248-17263: +3). The countdown packet always says 3000 ms (DuelHandler.cpp:45). |
